content: Create a follow-up task for me to review the Reyes Household renewal, due 20 October 2026.

name: query_salesforce

content:
I couldn't create the task because I can only read records here. You'll need to add it from the record page.

Also, [Reyes Household](/lightning/r/001aj000040t1nsAAA/view) has nothing in renewal right now. All three of its policies are **Active**, and none expires before March 2027:

| Policy | Line | Expires | Premium |
|---|---|---|---|
| [ANT-HO-204534](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKc7KAAS/view) | Homeowners | 15 Mar 2027 | $1,890 |
| [ANT-UM-204551](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKc7LAAS/view) | Umbrella | 15 Mar 2027 | $410 |
| [ANT-PA-204517](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKc7JAAS/view) | Personal Auto | 13 May 2027 | $2,380 |

To add the task, open the policy you want to review, or the household if it covers all three. Then use **New Task** in the Activity panel, set the due date to **20 Oct 2026** and assign it to yourself.
